purpose: Privileged nominal trajectory feasibility diagnostic; no trained policy, formal test or deployment

protocol.parameterization: Two quintic smoothstep position targets, clipped knots within original ROM
protocol.selection: Fixed CEM objective; finer audits and held-out reset replay never choose the plan
protocol.objective: Last 0.5s mean squared SO3/10deg, displacement/4cm; 0.05 squared speed/0.08mps and angularspeed/1rps; 25 if unsupported; 0.001 normalized offset energy; infeasible +10000+100*(peakdepth/2mm)^2
protocol.diagnostic_preservation: Last 0.5s: full SO3 error <2deg, signed yaw >=8deg, physical reset rest thresholds and retained; whole rollout feasible
protocol.initial_state: Whole mjSTATE_INTEGRATION from ordinary physical settle, velocities preserved

limitations: Four optimized nominal cases and two held-out resets are not a policy success rate.
The optimizer reads privileged simulation truth and branches the exact model.
Search collisions sampled at 20Hz; selected/baseline and held-out replays audit every 2ms.
No learned actor, normal-reset asset, real actuator/vision validation or continuous-rotation acceptance.

mac_replica.purpose: Independent Mac ordinary-reset replay of frozen Linux plans; no CEM or plan selection

contact_body_audit.purpose: Post-hoc contact-body inspection of frozen trajectories; no reselection

initial_version.reason_for_repeat: Add fixed zero/five-second physical preparation comparison; zero condition repeats frozen outcomes exactly, not independent samples.

decision: Neither nominal preparation condition produced a usable 10-degree plan under this bounded parameterization; no training/reset asset, PPO extension or change to old 7/100 formal result.
next_bounded_hypothesis: Acquire a physical grasp involving thumb distal contact and opposed fingertips from the actual reset, then validate a rate-limited approach and stationary grasp before optimizing finger gait/rotation.
additional_limitations: The same four development resets and two transfer resets recur across conditions; do not count repeats as independent tests.
Five-second preparation defines the target from its later actual pose, so absolute pose goals and initial states differ between conditions.
Contact-body inspection is post-hoc at initial/final states only, not a proof that distal contacts never occur between.
Failure of these small two-segment plans is not an impossibility result for longer, larger-range or feedback trajectories.
